DON_QUIXOTE_KEYWORD_BLOOD_FORGE.title: Bloodforge X
DON_QUIXOTE_KEYWORD_BLOOD_FORGE.descript:
Spend X [gold]Hardblood[/gold] when playing this card; you may still play it without enough [gold]Hardblood[/gold].
The first time you Bloodforge each combat, add a [gold]Knight's Lance[/gold] to your hand; your [gold]Knight's Lance[/gold] and Lance Gorged on Blood deal X more damage.
If you lack [gold]Hardblood[/gold], each [gold]Hardblood[/gold] actually spent adds 1 more damage.
DON_QUIXOTE_KEYWORD_TECHNIQUE.title: Technique X
DON_QUIXOTE_KEYWORD_TECHNIQUE.descriptio: The first time you use Technique each combat, add a [gold]Knight's Lance[/gold] to your hand; your [gold]Knight's Lance[/gold] and Lance Gorged on Blood attack X additional times.
DON_QUIXOTE_KEYWORD_AMPLIFY.title: Amplify X
DON_QUIXOTE_KEYWORD_AMPLIFY.description: The first time you Amplify each combat, add a [gold]Knight's Lance[/gold] to your hand; your [gold]Knight's Lance[/gold] gains X [gold]Blood Armor[/gold] and X [gold]Shimmering【Bloodfiend】[/gold], and your Lance Gorged on Blood triggers [red]Bleed[/red] X additional times.
DON_QUIXOTE_KEYWORD_KNIGHT.title: Knight
DON_QUIXOTE_KEYWORD_KNIGHT.description: Deals +50% damage to enemies with [gold]Duel Target[/gold].
